name: startup_idea_review
description: Concept validation for an automated IT implementation consulting startup using AI agents, aiming to probe market potential, feasibility, economics, go-to-market, and confirm next steps.

sections.label: Problem and status quo
sections.description: Pain points in IT implementation consulting today, who feels them, and how teams solve them now (processes, tools, services).

sections.label: Market, customers, and positioning
sections.description: Ideal customer profiles and use cases, buyer vs. user roles and procurement context, market size and timing, notable competitors/substitutes, and clear differentiation/defensibility of the AI-agent approach.

sections.label: Solution scope and operating model
sections.description: What the AI agents do end-to-end, MVP scope and workflow boundaries, level of automation vs. human-in-the-loop and QA/review steps, delivery model (product vs. service vs. hybrid) with expected service levels, and required team capabilities or partner gaps to deliver.

sections.label: Technical feasibility and data
sections.description: Required capabilities and integrations, data sources and access paths, reliability/performance constraints, and deployment architecture and security model needed to make the solution work.

sections.label: Go-to-market and pilots
sections.description: Acquisition channels and sales motion, partnerships and stakeholder mapping, change management and adoption plan, and concrete pilot or design-partner opportunities including intros and pilot success criteria/KPIs.

sections.label: Unit economics and pricing
sections.description: Pricing model options and willingness to pay, expected margins, key cost drivers (compute, labor, data), and CAC/LTV and payback considerations.

sections.label: Risks, regulatory, and operational
sections.description: Compliance and security constraints, data governance, delivery model risks, liability and SLAs, auditability and reliability thresholds, and validation or mitigation experiments, excluding adoption/change management (capture under go_to_market_and_pilots) and excluding operating model details (capture under solution_scope_and_operating_model).

sections.label: Decisions and next steps
sections.description: Decisions made and open questions, owners, deadlines, follow-ups needed (research, technical, customer), and requested intros or artifacts to exchange.

sections.label: Other
sections.description: Anything material that doesn't fit a declared section. Prefer declared sections; use this only when nothing else fits.

phases.label: Rapport
phases.goal: Set context, confirm objectives and timebox, and invite candid feedback.

phases.label: Explore market and problem
phases.goal: Understand the pain, who has it, the size and timing of the opportunity, and current alternatives.

phases.label: Test solution and feasibility
phases.goal: Pressure-test the proposed value prop, scope and operating model, and the technical/data assumptions; surface major risks.

phases.label: Go-to-market and economics
phases.goal: Map practical paths to early traction and validate pricing and unit economics.

phases.label: Wrap
phases.goal: Confirm takeaways, pilot or intro commitments, and concrete next steps and owners.
